notes.title: Pingo's Revenge Update V2.0
notes.content:
The long-awaited Update V2.0 is finally here for Pingo’s Revenge, bringing exciting improvements. In this update, we have focused extensively on revamping the User Interface (UI).

1. UI Overhaul:
We have comprehensively redesigned all user interfaces in the game to ensure a seamless and engaging player experience across various screen resolutions. Whether you're playing on a high-resolution monitor or an older screen, the new UI elements automatically adjust, ensuring the game remains clear and easily readable.

2. Redesign of the Options Menu:
The Options Menu now shines with a new look! We have rebuilt and designed it from the ground up to provide improved user-friendliness and a clear structure.

3. Thanks to the Community:
We want to express our heartfelt thanks to our community for the numerous valuable feedback. Your constructive input has allowed us to work on targeted improvements, now implemented in Update V2.0. Your enthusiasm and support are the driving force behind the evolution of our game, and we are grateful to have such a dedicated player base.

Update V2.0 is now available for download. Immerse yourself in the optimized world of Pingo’s Revenge and experience the game in a new dimension! Have fun playing, and thank you for your ongoing support.

Primer Games
